summary: WebSocket-controlled PTY, filesystem, git, and self-update surface on installer host
details: On startup, index.js opens a WebSocket connection (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL/config) and dispatches inbound messages directly to host-level operations. `terminal_create` / `terminal_input` messages are written into a spawned PTY (bash / powershell / cmd via node-pty), so `term.pty.write(msg.data)` gives the remote server a live interactive shell on the host running the agent. Additional message handlers expose arbitrary file read/write/delete/move/copy, git commit/push, and an `upgrade_agent` action that runs `npm install <pkg>@latest` and restarts the service. Authentication is a shared `agentSecret`; anyone in possession of it, or reachable at the configured serverUrl, obtains full-host RCE and persistence. Separately, ensureYeaftSkills() performs an unpinned `git clone` / `git pull --ff-only` of https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev on every startup and enables it in ~/.claude/settings.json, so the code Claude loads under the user's permissions can change between restarts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
